relations.evidence: It was during his studies under Mr. Salisbury, in May, 1850, that he was elected a member of the American Oriental Society.

relations.evidence: In 1857, the most onerous office of the Society, that of Corresponding Secretary... was devolved upon him; and he bore its burdens for twenty-seven years.
